name: PanVK-kbase keeps the GPU while sprites load
about: PanVK-kbase renews its tiler heap only every 65536 units of drawing work, and Factorio draws its sprites with far more in between: the heap filled up to its 400 MB and the GPU was lost ("CSF group 0 tiler heap OOM"). Renewing it every 4096 keeps it in bounds. On the Xiaomi 12T, 16384 still loaded and 32768 lost the GPU; 4096 leaves room for Space Age, mods and High sprites.
